work.name: c-sense GmbH

Delivered automated measurement workflows (spatial sampling, real-time safety management) demanding concurrency and reliability, letting researchers focus on experimental outcomes rather than instrument operation

projects.name: Personal Hetzner Infrastructure — Live GitOps Cluster
projects.description: A personal production infrastructure running live on a Hetzner cloud server: a k3s Kubernetes cluster with ArgoCD-driven GitOps, deploying multiple self-hosted applications.
highlights: Runs a k3s cluster on a Hetzner CX23 instance with ArgoCD continuously reconciling application state from Git
Operates the full deployment lifecycle (build, containerize, deploy, observe) for live self-hosted services
Configured Traefik ingress (hostname-based routing) and cert-manager for automatic Let's Encrypt TLS certificate provisioning and renewal
Pinned deployments by immutable image SHA rather than mutable tags so Git remains an exact source of truth and ArgoCD reliably detects changes

projects.name: Inception-of-Things — K3s Kubernetes Cluster

Configured Kubernetes ingress, service routing, and workload deployment across cluster nodes
Applied GitOps principles with ArgoCD for continuous deployment in the bonus track
